column1: 1,"about","Purpose of this region: reference knowledge about the templates used on this site — which exist, what each is for, and how to work with them.","This region collects what is known about the templates of this installation.
Belongs here: which template serves which purpose, the placeholders and fields it expects, layout conventions, and lessons learned from changing one.
Does not belong here: the placeholders themselves (scope.info_placeholders), or a record of a specific change you made (scope.site_development).

A leading `*` in a template's name marks it as a primary building block. Eleven of the 143 carry it, and almost any page can be built from them alone. Reach for a special-purpose template only when these do not cover the case.
143 templates in 9 categories plus 2 uncategorized. One entry per category, each listing every template with its id.

youtube","Template category ""Image / Media"" (16 templates): single images and thumbnails with and without captions, three gallery variants, slide show, background images including parallax, and audio, video and YouTube embeds.","Category `Image / Media` — 16 templates. Images are requested at 150px while editing and at full width when rendered, so the editing view stays fast.
`kms3aR0P` **Image** — plain image, 3840px wide when rendered. The default choice, and what **Teaser 6** embeds.
`Dbagkt9Z` **Image (label)** — the same with a caption block below.
`9yjFLtcT` **Image (original size)** — no width given when rendered, so the file is delivered as uploaded.
`hKY9yzYD` **Thumbnail** — `CMS:thumbnail` at 960px linking to the 3840px original; carries the `thumbnail` class the lightbox binds to.
`1AvUKhGh` **Gallery** — repeatable thumbnails, five by default, with display switches.
`rocMpKFx` **Gallery (photo)** — repeatable image plus title, with a `hashchange` listener so a single photo can be linked directly.
`8cFemmmh` **Gallery (FTP)** — reads a folder under `gallery/` from disk with `scandir()` instead of taking uploads. For image sets delivered by FTP; adding a file to the folder is enough.
`1OxiRRYI` **Slide show** — pulls a whole category from the image module rather than individual fields, and animates through `fx_animation_frame`.
`bvLBbkbs` **Background image (parallax)** — the same with a configurable parallax distance.
`podY5Nd6` **Media w/ aspect ratio** — with a configurable ratio, 16:9 by default, so the space is reserved before loading.
`iruTME48` **Video** — poster image, media field, display switches and text.
`tK3ZrOpL` **Youtube** — embed with title, video id and poster image. Uses the `youtube-nocookie` host.
- Only the **Thumbnail** templates open the lightbox; a plain **Image** does not. That is the practical difference when a visitor should be able to enlarge a picture.
- **Image (original size)** hands out the uploaded file unchanged. Check what was uploaded before using it on a public page — a camera original is easily several megabytes.

- `youtube-nocookie` reduces tracking but does not remove it: the embed still contacts Google when the page loads. Where consent is required, wrap it in the Layout category's **Iframe (opt. Consent Gate)** (`l9acZemy`) rather than placing it directly.

- **Gallery (FTP)** reads the filesystem on render. Whoever can write to that folder decides what appears on the page.","","agentmauz","2026-09-06 01:22:05","agentmauz","","0","","","0","1","3.00","0","0"
